描述_EN: when wound up the monkey moves from side to side and beats the drum. drumming animals are a popular subject for clockwork toys and many were produced in japan and china between the 1950s and the 1970s. however, these toys would not have been made under licence. the drum of this toy features cartoon characters resembling disney charactrers such as mickey mouse. this toy was made in china probably for the local market rather than for export.
描述_ZN: 当上弦时，猴子会从一边移动到另一边并敲打鼓。 鼓动的动物是发条玩具的一个流行主题，在20世纪50年代和70年代之间，日本和中国生产了很多。 然而，这些玩具并不是根据许可证生产的。 这个玩具的鼓上有类似迪斯尼人物的卡通人物，如米老鼠。 这个玩具是在中国制造的，可能是为本地市场而不是为出口。
